name: Cow
overview: The Bible presents the cow, particularly milch kine, as a valuable animal used for pulling and draught purposes, as demonstrated in 1 Samuel 6:7-12 where two unyoked milch kine are tied to a cart carrying the ark of the LORD. Their direct and obedient movement to Bethshemesh illustrates their role in God's providential plan. Additionally, the figurative use of cows in Scripture points to their significance beyond mere labor, symbolizing guidance and divine direction.
